title: Wildfire Ignition Research (B-Roll)
description: Researchers set up drone equipment for a project led by research mechanical engineer Dan Jimenez from the Missoula Fire Sciences Laboratory at Lubrecht Experimental Forest in Montana on Sept. 18, 2025, to study how heat transfer affects wildfire ignition. The research will inform future fuel treatments, fuel breaks and fire suppression tactics. (Forest Service video by Erika Reiter)
